notes: run.js keeps no job id in the URL or storage, so the page cannot show a finished job again. The one-person sample was therefore run once at mweb (job 97e6e1019cf9, frame 04) and once at desktop (job 64c74598e425, frame 08). The mweb run came first because mweb is first in the capture order.
The status_sequence of the mweb job ends at "Running: writing files, 0 of 1." because the 150 ms status observer missed the last text change; the frame itself shows "Done in 141 s.".

The Feedback button at the bottom left of the two run-result frames is the gateway-injected feedback widget, not part of the app. It also causes the one Content Security Policy console error (inline style) on the pages that load it.
On the mweb contract frame the Schemas and Compatibility tables scroll sideways inside their wrapper, so their right-hand columns are clipped in the frame. That is the page's own layout at 393 px.
The Canvas2D getImageData warnings come from the capture script's own canvas-drawn check, not from the app.
No page failed to render and no retry was needed. No frame was edited after capture.
The capture script and scratch files are outside the repo, in the maintainers' local state directory.
